decisions.text: removes: ending the running sleep at a chosen earlier time from the hold sheet (F9) — the time field there is now the start (mode 1), so 'סיים שינה נוכחית' ends at now; an earlier end is still possible by editing the closed sleep on the timeline — reverse: give the end button its own time field in mode 1

removes: the end-time field when editing the open sleep from the timeline or banner (it could close the sleep) — D-015-1 says time only — reverse: show the sleepEnd picker again when editingOpenSleep()

removes: the picker's '+5 minutes' arrow and the 'לפני 15 דק׳' / 'לפני שעה' chips (relative to now) — replaced by the chips D-015-3 lists (עכשיו, −5, −15, −30 relative to the value) — reverse: add the chips back in datetime24.html
removes: the API error code allergen_meal_1 (422) on calendar create/move and suggestion accept — reverse: restore checkPlacement in server/domain/calendar-rules.js and its calls

behaviour: a time-only start (mode 1 and editing the open sleep) is read as the latest such time that is not in the future (today, or yesterday when today's would be ahead), so a sleep started before midnight can be set — reverse: use the date part of the field (the old start's date) in saveFixStart() and build()
behaviour: saving mode 1 closes the sheet and shows the toast 'שעת ההירדמות עודכנה'; a future start shows 'שעת ההירדמות לא יכולה להיות בעתיד' — reverse: remove the toast in saveFixStart()
behaviour: the end-or-keep question shows after the sheet closes; Escape or a tap on the backdrop counts as 'להשאיר פעילה' — reverse: close the sheet only after askEndOrKeep() answers

behaviour: typing fewer than 4 digits and leaving the field shows the error and keeps the previous value; 4 digits that are not a real time (25:10) show the error at once — reverse: change onTypedBlur() to revert silently
behaviour: the allergen note also shows after adding an allergen food to meal 2 or 3 through the add-food sheet, not only after a move — reverse: drop the noteAllergenMeal call in pickFood()
behaviour: weight stats totals now carry rangeDays and daysWithData too, so all six kinds match — reverse: remove both fields from weightStats()
